# SYNESIS_E098 — Warning

## Description

Reason.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: reason.
  With more than one block of the same format, each one needs a unique
  name in the project (`EXPORT JSON panel`), so `synesis export` can choose.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AmbiguousExportName**: `block`, `reason`
